summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does prefix matching via startswith, and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ (inherited by _RDFNamespace) returns True only for stored term URIs. Added NamespaceContainsTest to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership on Namespace, closed membership on RDFS and RDF, and the container-property negative case. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. Some new test lines exceed 88 characters and may fail a black/flake8 check. Nothing is committed.
